Kidical Mass Saint Paul organizes family-friendly bike rides to normalize cycling for children. By using public streets, they aim to shift the perception of roads from car-only zones to shared community spaces.

The Bright Side:
These rides provide a low-barrier entry point for families to experience the city, effectively reducing the isolation often felt in car-dependent suburban designs.
